payload.name: Intermittent control in human quiet stance
payload.fact: Optimal neural control for balancing a one-segment inverted pendulum model, derived via delayed reinforcement learning, exhibits intermittent rather than continuous characteristics.

provenance.title: Delayed reinforcement learning converges to intermittent control for human quiet stance.
provenance.quote_or_locus: The simulation results indicated that the optimal neural controller exhibits intermittent, and not continuous, characteristics
